purpose: Name the scene-gated type-0x62 response-template pair used by the interaction dispatch block.

templates.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_62_DEFAULT_RESPONSE
templates.selection: Chosen when the gate at 0x00FFF10E is set and SCENE_STATE at 0x00FF7E26 is not 0x05.

templates.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_62_SCENE5_RESPONSE
templates.selection: Chosen when the gate at 0x00FFF10E is set and SCENE_STATE equals 0x05.

shared_post_spawn: Both paths subtract 0x08 from the allocated actor's Y position when LevelObjectSpawnVariant succeeds; the helper does not consume the interaction byte.
conclusion: The type-0x62 pair is an explicit scene-gated response selection: the default and scene-5 records differ only in their animation roots and resource counts, and both share the same spawn helper and Y correction.
